meta.orientation: every [a, b] pair is [A, B] = the two names of the ufcstats BOUT string in order
meta.rounds: one row per scored round of a decision. Stats are ufcstats per-round counts for A and B (x_l landed, x_a attempted; sig = head+body+leg = dist+clinch+ground; ctrl in seconds; kd, sub (attempts), rev (reversals)). mins = round length actually fought. end_rnd = the fight ended in this round (technical decisions can end early). ded_A/ded_B = points deducted from A/B in the round (null if unknown). nA/nB/nE = judges giving the round to A/B/even before deductions (published when raw_known=false); n_wide = judges with a margin >= 2 (10-8 or wider). complete = every judge scored the same rounds 1..R and R fits how the fight ended; ufc_check = agreement of the fight's card totals with ufcstats (agree, agree_partial_panel, totals_agree_names_differ, differs, differs_partial_panel, n/a). A clean training subset: complete & ufc_check in (agree, agree_partial_panel, totals_agree_names_differ).
meta.scores: one row per judge per round: ri = row index into rounds.rows, jid = MMA Decisions judge id (negative = no id, matched by name), pos = card position on MMA Decisions, A/B = published score, A_raw/B_raw = before deductions (null when unknown). jp_fights, jp_rounds, jp_wide, jp_even, jp_oa, jp_dis = the judge's history on dates strictly before this fight (walk-forward safe): earlier fights, rounds, 10-8-or-wider rounds, 10-10 rounds, rounds where the other two judges agreed, and of those the rounds this judge differed (null for unnamed judges).

labels_or_derived_from_scores: end_rnd (with winner: how the fight ended)
column_roles.in_round_inputs: A_*/B_* ufcstats counts for the same round and mins: known only after the round, so a pre-fight forecast must simulate them
column_roles.warning: never feed winner, nA/nB/nE/n_wide, ufc_check or complete to a model that predicts the round scores: they are computed from those scores. A is the first name in the ufcstats BOUT string and wins the majority in about 57% of three-judge dev rounds (report_dev.rounds3_majority_to_A; ufcstats lists the winner first more often), so train and evaluate symmetrically (mirror A/B), docs/BACKLOG.md.

meta.load: pd.DataFrame(d['rounds']['rows'], columns=d['rounds']['cols']); same for scores; merge scores.ri -> rounds index
